reaction_description: An alkene, PhI(OAc)2, and a tridentate palladium complex immobilized on magnetic particles were combined in DMF/AcOH under nitrogen.
raw_text: An alkene (0.50 mmol, 1.0 equiv), PhI(OAc)2 (1.2 equiv), and a tridentate palladium complex immobilized on magnetic particles (3.5 mol%) were combined in DMF/AcOH (1:2) under nitrogen. The mixture was stirred at 20 C for 5 h to give the dioxygenated alkene in 86% yield.
